payload.note: Change in supply by acquisition price, 2026-10-11 to 2026-11-10. Green = coins whose cost basis is here grew (accumulation); red = that cohort was spent/moved (distribution). Coins leaving a bucket at a price above their cost basis is realised profit, below it is realised loss. cum_acc/cum_dist are cumulative shares measured UP the price axis (large at the top of the range), not per bucket. The newest dated curves are still being restated upstream, so a window ending at 2026-11-10 is provisional. DATA VINTAGE 2026-11-10 — a dated measurement, not a live tape.
